note: Inventory re-derived from the current v2 design. Statuses record current implementation evidence and platform blockers; layout, visual state and interaction fidelity remain human-read checks.

elements.name: Sessions empty and ready states
copy: The daemon is answering and two repositories are visible to it. A session is a worktree plus a thread, so starting one never touches your checkout.

elements.name: Failed session read state
copy: The daemon accepted the connection and then stopped answering mid-read. Domovoi will not show a partial thread, because a partial thread reads like a finished one.
nothing was written, nothing was lost
evidence: nothing was written, nothing was lost

elements.name: Cross-machine search state
copy: Nothing matched on the two machines that answered
wsl-ubuntu-24 did not answer, so its sessions were not searched. This is not the same as having no results, and Domovoi will not round it down to one.

missing.reason: Cross-machine search is not exposed as the design draws it.

elements.name: Worktree ready state
copy: The session exists, the worktree is cut, and the agent has not been given a turn. Your first message is what starts it.
OR START FROM SOMETHING IT ALREADY KNOWS
Say what you want done in acme-api

partial.reason: The phone draws Nothing has run yet on an empty session. Desktop and web draw no session start state, and no client draws the Worktree ready header.
